purpose: Validate that housing and workplace scenario effects are distributed over their declared phase-in years without loss, duplication or leakage outside the phase window.
requiredChecks: scenario effect is zero before start year
scenario effect is zero after the final phase year
annual phase increments are equal within a row
sum of annual housing external effects equals the declared full housing external effect
sum of annual workplace external effects equals the declared full workplace external effect
phaseYears values below 1 fall back to exactly one year rather than division by zero
changing phaseYears changes timing only, not the cumulative scenario total
governance: Phase-in is a timing assumption, not a change in cumulative scenario magnitude.
Housing and workplace scenarios use the same deterministic phase-in rule.
Any future non-uniform ramp shape must be introduced as a separately documented scenario method.
